text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとヴァンは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Vaan are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとヴァンは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Vaan are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
けれどそんなヴァンが、義務や責任を負う
人々の心を解きほぐしていったのです。
text.official_en: Vaan spoke in a similar manner, and thus was able to break down barriers that others had erected around themselves.
text.real_en: Yet Vaan’s frankness helped put people burdened by duty and responsibility at ease.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
ごくふつうの市民として育った自分が
王女や皇子といった人々に接したら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you—someone who lived a normal life as a commoner—to suddenly share the company of princes and princesses, what would you do?

text.jp:
そして彼らの旅は帝国を越え、神秘の領域へ。
歴史をあやつる種族から、ある誘いを受けます。
text.official_en: During the course of their journey, Vaan’s party reached a hallowed realm. There, the stewards of history requested of them the following:
text.real_en: Their journey then led them beyond the empire, into a mysterious realm, where a people who controlled history made them an offer.

text.jp:
その若者は、戦争でたったひとりの兄を失い
孤児となっても、たくましく生きていました。
text.official_en: One of the kingdom’s citizens, despite becoming orphaned when his brother was killed in the war, managed to find the strength to carry on.
text.real_en: A young man lost his only brother in the war and became an orphan, yet still found the strength to live on.

text.jp: それは、戦乱の空に自由を夢見る異界の記憶――
text.official_en: In this world that had been ravaged by war, some looked to the skies for freedom.
text.real_en: A memory of another world dreaming of freedom beneath skies torn by war...

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
やがて彼は帝国に抵抗する解放軍にかかわり
広大なイヴァリースの世界を駆けめぐります。
text.official_en: As time went on, Vaan came into contact with a resistance group, which would lead him to embark on a journey around all of Ivalice.
text.real_en: He became involved with a resistance army fighting the empire and traveled across the vast world of Ivalice.

text.jp: やりたいことがわからない
text.official_en: You would not, for you know not how.
text.real_en: Not know what you wanted to do.

text.jp: わからなくても思いやる
text.official_en: Be kind to others, if not prim and proper.
text.real_en: Treat them with consideration, even if you do not understand.

text.jp:
ヴァンの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.
text.real_en: Vaan’s feelings will become a Vision, and surely a source of hope for you.

text.jp:
ヴァンは、飛空艇で自由に世界を翔ける
空賊にあこがれていました。
text.official_en: Vaan, for one, wished to become a sky pirate so he could travel by airship to wherever he pleased.

text.jp:
亡き人の痛みは、何をしても癒やせないから
いまを生きる者が、悲しみを乗り越える。
text.official_en: There is naught that can heal the pains of the fallen. All that can be done is for the living to overcome their own sorrow.
text.real_en: Nothing you do can heal the pain of those who have died. It is the living who must overcome their grief.

text.jp:
出会ったのは、空賊や騎士に王侯貴族など
さまざまな身分や立場の人々でした。
text.official_en: During his travels, he met people of all stripes and walks of life—from sky pirates to knights and even to royalty.

text.jp:
国と国が争う時代だからこそ、国境のない
大空に、希望の翼が広がります。
text.official_en: Should one’s land be mired in conflict between countries, perhaps one should spread their wings and take to the skies, where countries do not exist.
text.real_en: Precisely because nations are at war, the boundless sky offers wings of hope.

text.jp:
国を守って死んだ者たちのために復讐を。
破滅の力を手に入れ……帝国を滅ぼせと。
text.official_en: Exact revenge for those who died in defense of their nation...by attaining devastating power, and with it, bringing ruin unto the empire.

text.jp:
大切な人々を奪った帝国を許せなくても
復讐は報復を招き、また新たな血が流れる。
text.official_en: Though the empire may have taken many lives, and though their actions may be unforgivable, exacting revenge would only beget more bloodshed.

text.jp:
帝国がひそかに狙う秘宝を盗んだことで
ヴァンは時代の嵐に飛びこむのです。
text.official_en: Vaan, too, sought to reclaim some treasures for Dalmasca, and in doing so, dove into the eye of a veritable storm.
text.real_en: By stealing a treasure the empire secretly sought, Vaan was swept into the turmoil of his age.

text.jp:
帝国に占領された街での
退屈な日常を変えるには――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Had your nation been occupied by a foreign power for years, and had your days become marked by utter monotony, how would you rectify that?
text.real_en: If you wanted to change your dull everyday life in a city occupied by an empire, what would you do?

text.jp:
帝国に支配されても、心は誇り高く。
自由を取り戻す機会は、きっと見つかります。
text.official_en: Though they may control your country, so long as they do not control its people, it may still be possible for you to reclaim your freedom.
text.real_en: Even under imperial rule, you would keep your pride. Surely an opportunity to regain your freedom will come.

text.jp: 帝国に立ち向かう
text.official_en: Rise up against that foreign power.

text.jp:
帝国への恨みや、空へのあこがれを
口にしても、何をすべきかわからない……。
text.official_en: You may say you loathe your oppressors, or that you yearn to be free, yet you know not how to put those words into action.
text.real_en: You can voice your resentment of the empire and your longing for the skies, yet still have no idea what you should do...

text.jp:
彼の名は、ヴァン……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That Dalmascan’s name is Vaan, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was Vaan... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
復讐が実は無意味でも、やりきれない想いを
晴らす手段がなければ……否定はできません。
text.official_en: An understandable position. While revenge may ultimately be futile, it can provide an outlet for emotions most unbearable.
text.real_en: Even if revenge is ultimately meaningless, it is hard to deny someone that outlet for unbearable feelings.

text.jp: 復讐すれば救われる
text.official_en: “Revenge offers release.”
text.real_en: Revenge would bring relief.

text.jp:
復讐では死者を救えないと語りかけたのは
悩みながら兄の死を受け止めたヴァンでした。
text.official_en: After Vaan came to terms with his brother’s death, he espoused much the same sentiment—that he could not help him anymore.
text.real_en: It was Vaan, who struggled to accept his brother’s death, who argued that revenge cannot save the dead.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. If you were...

text.jp: 悲劇はくりかえせない
text.official_en: “’An eye for an eye’ is not the answer.”
text.real_en: We cannot let the tragedy repeat itself.

text.jp:
戦乱の空にはばたく異界の幻影　ヴァン
義務に縛られることなく、風のごとく自由に。
text.official_en:
Soarer of the Skies Vaan
The young man who lives free as the wind, unbound by obligation.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision soaring through skies of war: Vaan. Free as the wind, unbound by duty.

text.jp:
戦争で家族を亡くしたヴァンたちは
同じ悲劇をくりかえすことを拒んだのです。
text.official_en: As Vaan knew how difficult losing family to war can be, he could not bear to consign others to the same fate.
text.real_en: Vaan and his companions, who had lost family to war, refused to let the same tragedy happen again.

text.jp:
手を取り合う未来への希望がなければ
彼らも思いとどまれなかったかもしれません。
text.official_en: Had Vaan’s party no future toward which to reach, no hope to which to cling, they may have become harbingers of ruin.
text.real_en: Without hope for a future where people could join hands, they might not have been able to stop themselves.

text.jp:
政治や外交には疎いヴァンでしたが
知らないなりに思いやる優しさがありました。
text.official_en: Neither politics nor diplomacy were Vaan’s forte, yet his genuine concern and kindness were quite effective.
text.real_en: Vaan knew little of politics or diplomacy, but cared for others even when he did not understand their circumstances.

text.jp:
歴史あるダルマスカ王国が、
帝国に征服された戦争から二年……。
text.official_en: The tale begins in the Kingdom of Dalmasca, which had fallen under an empire’s control two years prior.

text.jp:
死んでいった者の恨みを晴らすため、
人々が暮らす帝国を滅ぼすのか――
あなたは、どう思いますか？
text.official_en: Were you tasked with avenging fallen soldiers—and in the process of doing so, destroying an entire nation—what thought would cross your mind?
text.real_en: Would you destroy an empire where people live to avenge those who died? What do you think?

text.jp: 死者の想いは癒やせない
text.official_en: “Revenge heals nothing.”
text.real_en: We cannot ease the feelings of the dead.

text.jp:
物怖じも気取りもないヴァンの態度が
事態を動かすことが何度もありました。
text.official_en: Had Vaan always behaved as was expected of him, he would not have made nearly as many inroads as he did.
text.real_en: Vaan’s unpretentious, fearless manner often helped move things forward.

text.jp:
生まれた国や立場は違えど、ひとりの人間として
相対すれば、想いは伝わるものです。
text.official_en: While those you meet may be of disparate upbringings or stations, treat them as fellow humans and your message shall never fail to reach them.
text.real_en: No matter where people are born or what their station is, meeting them as fellow human beings can convey your feelings.

text.jp: 礼儀正しくわきまえる
text.official_en: Become the personification of propriety.
text.real_en: Be polite and mindful of their position.

text.jp:
立場をわきまえ、無礼のないよう
振る舞うことも大切ですが……
text.official_en: Though valuable, proper etiquette is neither the be-all nor end-all of social interaction.
text.real_en: It is important to know your place and avoid being rude, but...

text.jp: 素直に言いたいことを言う
text.official_en: Speak your mind.

text.jp: 自由な空にあこがれる
text.official_en: Dream of taking to the skies.

text.jp:
身分は気にせず、誰とでも率直に話し合う。
時には相手を怒らせることもあるでしょう。
text.official_en: Albeit at the risk of angering some, being ignorant of the social hierarchy allows one to speak plainly and sincerely.
text.real_en: Speak frankly with anyone, regardless of their status. Sometimes that may anger them.

text.jp:
進む道が見えない焦りや苛立ち。
向き合えば、いつか乗り越えられます。
text.official_en: While frustration and anxiety may nip at your heels, a deep look inward should put them far behind you.
text.real_en: The frustration of not knowing which way to go... By facing it, you may someday overcome it.
